name: @inodra/mcp-server

tools.name: inodraConnect
tools.description: Connect this server to the user's Inodra account. Opens the Inodra dashboard in the user's browser on this machine and returns at once; after the user clicks Connect there, call this tool again (or any Inodra tool) and the full tool set is available. Call this when no other Inodra tool is listed. If the server runs on a remote machine (SSH, Codespaces, cloud), tell the user to run `npx @inodra/mcp-server connect --paste` in that machine's terminal instead.

client.description: Name of this MCP client, shown on the approval page

instructions: Inodra serves Sui data over gRPC with full history. Prefer the domain tools (inodraAccount, inodraObject, inodraTransaction, inodraChain) and use inodraGrpc for anything else. This server never signs. To send coins, build the transaction in code with @mysten/sui: draw the amount from the sender's address balance with tx.coin({ type, balance }) and deposit it with 0x2::coin::send_funds. Do not split or transfer coin objects for a plain send. Then simulate and execute the BCS bytes with inodraGrpc.
